verdict.rationale: Sketch's AI page describes AI acting on the user's own documents: complementary named color palettes generated from a photo, context-aware replacement of placeholder text, and automatic sorting, renaming and aligning of layers. These features appear to run through a built-in local MCP server that external AI clients such as ChatGPT or Claude connect to, rather than a native in-product assistant, so the user needs their own AI tool. They are also mostly automated actions rather than insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. Missing for 10: a native in-app AI that surfaces insights or recommendations about the user's designs, analysis or reporting-style insights, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
